app/app/lib/api.server.ts:7-24 — API base URL, TTL and cache all in one module

changeability.rationale: The headline bug fixes (sprite, API source, caching) each land in one obvious place, but the URL-param-input sync pattern and the Move API record type are duplicated, so some fixes land twice.

evidence: app/app/lib/api.server.ts:31-38 — all HTTP goes through one api()/apiOr404(); loaders never call fetch directly

app/app/components/PokemonCards.tsx:6 — cards driven by a narrow Card type plus an itemExtra render prop, no route knowledge
app/app/lib/team.server.ts:1-9 — team storage isolated behind readTeam/teamCookie; cookie shape changed nowhere else

coupling.rationale: Server/client separation and prop-driven components are clean seams; the tangles are small (hardcoded action URLs, ability-specific hidden flag on the shared Card type) and local to one file.

evidence: app/app/lib/api.server.ts:154-166 — pokemonCards maps Pokémon refs to species cards with an extra() hook, absorbing the real variation across moves/abilities/types without copying
app/app/components/MoveTable.tsx:18-27 — declarative column descriptors make sorting/aria-sort extensible without flags beyond showLevel
app/app/components/Section.tsx:6-9 — small section+heading abstraction used uniformly on every page
app/app/lib/api.server.ts:137 — speciesCard(index, id, withTypes) absorbs the one real card variation with a default-off boolean rather than a fork
app/app/lib/types.ts:10 — Card.hidden is ability-specific knowledge embedded in the generic card model, early flag creep
abstraction_design.rationale: The card pipeline, Section and column-descriptor table are designed around the app's actual variation and stretched to the Team feature via a render prop rather than a copy; only minor boolean-flag creep keeps it from exemplary.

findings.issue: Pre-hydration input workaround plus two effects that sync uncontrolled inputs with the URL via refs and document.activeElement; adding or changing a filter requires ~8 coordinated edits in one file and the timing assumptions are fragile.
findings.suggestion: Replace with controlled inputs whose value derives from loaderData and a single effect that pushes changes into navigate(), or extract a small useSearchParamField hook.

findings.issue: The URL-driven select pattern (sync value, apply pre-hydration input) is duplicated from home.tsx with slight variations, so a behavioral fix to the pattern must be made twice.
findings.suggestion: Extract one shared hook (e.g. useUrlParamSelect) used by both the home filters and the game picker.

findings.issue: The Move API record type is defined twice (a subset here, the full shape in routes/move.tsx:5-18), so an API shape change touches both files.
findings.suggestion: Move API record types (Move, Species, Pokemon, Ability) into lib/types.ts or a lib/pokeapi.ts alongside TypeRecord.

findings.issue: Table body cells are hand-rendered per column while headers iterate COLUMNS, so the column list exists twice and adding a column means editing both.
findings.suggestion: Render cells by mapping the same columns array (with a per-column cell renderer) so headers and body cannot drift.

findings.issue: The catch-all route renders null and throws a 404 from its loader, delegating the actual Not found UI to root.tsx:63-70 — an indirection a maintainer must discover before changing 404 behavior.
findings.suggestion: Render the NotFound UI in routes/not-found.tsx's default export (or ErrorBoundary) and let root's boundary delegate, keeping 404 UI in one place.

findings.issue: Both team controls hardcode the '/team' action URL, so relocating or renaming the team route breaks add/remove silently (404 action).
findings.suggestion: Export the action path as a constant from lib/team.ts, or use a fetcher keyed to a route id.

findings.issue: Document titles are rendered as <title> elements inside route components instead of meta exports (the documented framework-mode head seam, which v8 still supports and types against loaderData).
findings.suggestion: Migrate to export function meta({ loaderData }) per route so head concerns sit in the documented place.

findings.issue: Card.hidden plus the 'Hidden ability' note in PokemonCards bakes ability-specific semantics into the generic card model shared by every list.
findings.suggestion: Model the note generically (e.g. card.note) or pass it through the existing itemExtra/extra seam.

summary: This is a well-factored framework-mode app: server-only modules, one card pipeline every list flows through, and single-site control of the API base URL, caching and sprite URLs, so the classic bug-fix scenarios are one-file edits. The friction is concentrated in the hand-rolled URL-param input synchronization (duplicated across two routes) and small within-file duplications (MoveTable cells, inline API record types). Overall it changes safely and predictably, just short of exemplary.
